main.remarks: Evaluates an ordered set of policy-stages and stops on the first deny decision.

field.name: Stages
field.summary: Ordered policy-stages evaluated by the pipeline engine.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a pipeline access-policy engine from an ordered stage set.

param.name: stages
param.para: Null yields an empty stage set that always allows.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate the configured stage set for the supplied policy context.
method.returns: First deny decision from the stage set, or allow when every stage allows.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously the configured stage set for the supplied policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous pipeline evaluation.
method.returns: First deny decision from the stage set, or allow when every stage allows.
